summary: Master market entry strategy with practical tools for market selection, entry modes, risk analysis, and expansion planning. Enroll with TrainingCred.
lede: A market entry strategy is a structured approach to assessing a market, choosing an entry model, and aligning commercial, financial, and operational decisions. This course is for professionals responsible for evaluating and delivering expansion plans; it covers market screening, comparing options such as exporting, licensing, joint ventures, and direct investment, and building feasibility scenarios and risk plans.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to evaluate, justify, and operationalize market entry strategy and international expansion decisions across commercial, financial, and operational functions. Export Managers responsible for entering new foreign markets. International Business Development Managers evaluating expansion options. Strategy Managers shaping market selection and growth priorities. Commercial Directors approving entry mode and investment choices. Trade Compliance Specialists checking documentation and control requirements. Market Intelligence Analysts translating data into opportunity screens. Product Marketing Managers adapting offers for local demand. Channel Managers designing distributor and partner structures. Operations Managers planning logistics and service readiness. Finance Business Partners modelling landing cost and working capital.
prerequisites: Bring a laptop, spreadsheet software, and a current or hypothetical expansion case from your own work context. You will benefit most if you can access basic market data, internal pricing assumptions, and any existing go-to-market or export planning documents.
